title: Organotypic explant culture of adult rat retina for _in vitro_ investigations of neurodegeneration, neuroprotection and cell transplantation
protocol: Prepare an organotypic adult retinal explant culture.
Maintain the retinal explant culture with bi-daily medium exchanges.
Co-culture retinal explants with dissociated cell types such as stem cells.
Perform a pharmacological screen of neuroprotective drugs using retinal explants.
Preserve retinal explants for histological analysis.
Carry out cryostat sectioning of the retinal explants.
Perform fluorescent immunohistochemical labeling of whole-mount explants.
